description: Weighted preservation of report-critical facts, scored deterministically per annotated reference slot.
rules: Score only slots present in the human reference annotation.
A predicted slot is correct only when its normalized meaning matches the reference and its evidence span occurs verbatim in the evaluated transcript.
Partial credit is not permitted in v1.0.
Extra unsupported predicted slots count as hallucinations and are reported separately; they do not add denominator weight.
RIS equals 100 times the sum of weights for correct slots divided by the sum of weights for all reference slots.
If a clip has no reference slots, the clip is invalid and the run must fail validation.
Aggregate RIS is the arithmetic mean of valid per-clip RIS values, with provider failures retained as zero-score clips.
